title: market_data/weekly/{date}/constituents.json
description: Pinned CONSUMER copy, owned by crucible-executor (alpha-engine-config-I10796 / data_collection_plan_260914.md P-27). Producer: nousergon-data collectors/constituents.py::collect() (S&P 500 + S&P 400 membership). crucible-executor's read path (executor/eod_reconcile.py::_load_constituents_sector_map, shared by executor/signal_reader.py::patch_unknown_sectors_with_constituents on the pre-open path) consumes only `sector_map`, but the full producer shape is pinned here so a schema change anywhere in the object is caught, not only in the one field read today. As of this writing no producer-side contracts/ copy of this schema exists yet in nousergon-data (checked: no open PR under 'schema'/'contract' touching constituents.json as of 2026-09-14) — this pin is sourced directly from collectors/constituents.py's `result` dict and must be reconciled against the producer's own contracts/ file once P-07 lands there.

date.description: the weekly run_date this snapshot was written under

sp500_tickers.description: present only when sp500_count + sp400_count == len(tickers) (config-I6946); omitted otherwise rather than sliced on a count that doesn't describe the list

sector_map.description: ticker -> GICS sector name. THE field crucible-executor reads (_load_constituents_sector_map: `data.get('sector_map', {})`).

fetched_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch
